mostWorthwhile.text: Gathering the gas was most worthwhile: it connected gravity, cooling and cosmic expansion in a concise explanation.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the two neutral gases was straightforward and the only offered action, so it involved little decision-making.

surprise.text: I was struck that the universe became transparent before the first stars shone.

arbitrary.text: Combining primordial gas with trapped radiation felt somewhat symbolic rather than like a physical interaction, although the explanation made its purpose clear.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the dense gas cools and eventually forms stars, though the forced early choices were less engaging.
